messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out release v2.3.1 -> canary 10% to us-west-2. change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC :rocket:
Alice M: starting observability preflight, checking SLO dashboards and error budget panels :eyes:
Alice M: quick checks: p95 latency for prefix-cache route at baseline ~120ms, current baseline dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/prefix-cache-slo
Eng Runtime Bot: preflight checks passed: metrics stream OK, sampling rate 1% enabled, tracing enabled
Dave R: seeing a small bump in 5xx counts on canary hosts, not huge yet. @Alice M can you pull p50/p95 for the last 10m?
Alice M: grabbing 10m window...
Alice M: p50=85ms, p95=310ms for prefix-cache on canary nodes, baseline p95=120ms — spike concentrated on host canary-3
Carol S: any errors in the logs? could be a cache eviction bug after quantize path change
SRE Pager: alert triggered: prefix-cache.p95 > 250ms (canary group) :rotating_light: — alert id A-98321
Alice M: logs show repeated `KVCache::miss()` thrash and `oom` reclaim on canary-3 around 1732103580. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T22:13:00Z canary-3 kernel: reclaim invoked, free=8MB
2026-03-14T22:13:01Z service[redwood-runtime]: KVCache::miss batch=12 seq=4289
2026-03-14T22:13:02Z service[redwood-runtime]: runtime: allocation failed: fallback to slow-path
```
Dave R: that host is on the new kernel+cuda combo we rolled for quantize-compat testing. Could be memory pressure + new allocator.
Carol S: agree — this looks host-specific. Are other canaries healthy?
Alice M: canary-1/2 p95s stable (~130ms). traffic is at 10% split (2 instances canary-1/2 and canary-3).
deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to canary group (10%): instances=[canary-1, canary-2, canary-3]
SRE Pager: recommendation: pause rollout and pin traffic off canary-3.
Dave R: +1. Proposed action: set canary-3 drain and shift its 3.3% traffic back to baseline. Open a rollback if we see more hosts affected.
Alice M: doing quick pin via routing API:
```bash
# exclude canary-3 from canary pool
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood/rollouts/1732103456/pin -d '{"exclude": ["canary-3"]}'
```
Alice M: pinned canary-3 out, traffic now distributed to canary-1/2 -> effective canary sample now ~6.6%
Eng Runtime Bot: routing change applied, canary-3 set to draining=true, backends healthy: canary-1(OK), canary-2(OK), canary-3(DRAIN)
SRE Pager: re-evaluating SLOs after pin. If p95 remains >200ms for 5m across canary group, escalate to rollback.
Alice M: rechecked p95 (5m) after pin: canary group p95=140ms, canary-3 no longer contributing. 5xx rate back to baseline.
Carol S: we should file an infra ticket to repro on the new kernel image and revert image on canary-3. I'll create INF-4521 and assign to infra-ops.
Dave R: also add note to release notes: "v2.3.1: rolled canary 10% — observed KVCache pressure on new kernel image; canary-3 drained; investigating."
Alice M: tagging oncall and eng leads, and scheduling a follow-up post-mortem if INF-4521 shows regression.
SRE Pager: closing alert A-98321 as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 6.6% effective canary. Manual approval required to resume to 50% or full.
Carol S: next steps: INF-4521, revert image on canary-3 in next deploy window or repro in staging, and add a golden prompt/trace to Optimize evals to catch similar perf regressions in CI.
Alice M: ack. I'll update the release notes and ping product for the note.
Dave R: thanks team — good catch and quick pin.
Eng Runtime Bot: summary saved to thread. Link to action items: https://tickets.redwood/INF-4521, https://changelog.redwood/releases/v2.3.1
Alice M: thread locked for further noise, will update after infra triage. :lock:
